settings.text: Real feedback from real customers who made this part of their daily routine.
settings.caption: Results reflect self-reported customer feedback and may vary.

settings.title: Salicylic Acid
settings.text: Gently exfoliates to help smooth rough, bumpy texture by helping clear the buildup that often accumulates around hair follicles. Unlike physical scrubs, it works chemically at a gentler pace, which makes it easier on sensitive skin over time.

settings.title: Urea
settings.text: Softens and hydrates dry, rough patches by helping skin hold onto moisture more effectively. It's especially useful for areas that tend to feel rough or scaly, working alongside exfoliating ingredients rather than in place of them.

settings.title: Shea Butter
settings.text: Soothes and moisturizes sensitive skin, helping to counterbalance the exfoliating ingredients in the formula. It leaves skin feeling soft rather than stripped, which matters for areas that are already prone to irritation.

settings.title: Zero Fillers
settings.text: No harsh irritants or synthetic fragrances that can aggravate already-sensitive skin. We keep the formula focused on ingredients that address texture and hydration directly, without adding anything that could work against your skin.

settings.title: Step 1: Apply Daily
settings.text: Apply to clean, dry skin on affected areas once daily, focusing on spots with rough or bumpy texture. It's gentle enough for regular use on areas like arms and legs.

settings.title: Step 2: Massage In
settings.text: Gently massage until fully absorbed, taking a few extra seconds on particularly rough patches. There's no need to press hard or scrub — a gentle, even massage is all it takes.

settings.title: Step 3: Stay Consistent
settings.text: Use daily for at least 4 weeks to see the full results, since texture changes gradually rather than overnight. Skipping days here and there can slow down how quickly you notice a difference.

settings.description: Real transformations from customers who left a review.

settings.heading: How long until I see smoother skin?
settings.row_content: Most customers notice visibly smoother texture within 4 weeks of consistent daily use. Because keratosis pilaris tends to be a longer-term skin concern, gradual improvement over several weeks is typical rather than an overnight change. Staying consistent with daily application is the biggest factor in how quickly you'll notice a difference.

settings.heading: Is this safe for sensitive skin?
settings.row_content: Yes, it's formulated to be gentle, but we always recommend a patch test first if you have sensitive skin or are trying it for the first time. Apply a small amount to a discreet area and wait 24 hours before using it more broadly. If you notice any irritation, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

settings.heading: Where can I use this?
settings.row_content: It's designed for use on arms, legs, and other areas with rough, bumpy texture often associated with keratosis pilaris. It's not intended for use on the face or broken skin. Stick to the areas where texture concerns are most noticeable.

settings.heading: Can I use this every day?
settings.row_content: Yes, daily use is recommended for best results, since consistency is what drives improvement in skin texture over time. If your skin feels irritated at any point, it's fine to reduce to every other day and build back up as tolerated.

settings.heading: Smoother Skin, One Day At A Time

settings.text: A quick daily application is all it takes to start seeing softer, smoother skin over time. There's no harsh scrubbing required and no complicated multi-step process — just a simple, gentle habit you can build into your existing routine. Applied consistently, it works to soften rough texture and calm the appearance of bumps without irritating sensitive skin.

settings.caption: 01 — Formula
settings.heading: Gentle Exfoliation, Real Hydration
settings.text: Salicylic Acid gently exfoliates to help clear the buildup that often contributes to rough, bumpy texture, while Urea and Shea Butter work to soften and deeply hydrate the skin around it. Together, these ingredients are balanced to address both the texture and the dryness that often come with keratosis pilaris, without relying on harsh scrubs or irritating actives.

settings.caption: 02 — Routine
settings.heading: A Simple Daily Habit
settings.text: Apply to clean, dry skin once a day and stay consistent — smoother skin builds over time, not overnight. Because the formula is gentle enough for daily use on sensitive areas like arms and legs, it's easy to stick with long enough to actually see the difference.
